newsitem.title: UGANDA: Ugandan closes fish plants after Spanish complaints.
newsitem.headline: Ugandan closes fish plants after Spanish complaints.

text.p: Ugandas agriculture and fisheries ministry has closed nine fish processing plants along Lake Victoria after complaints from Spain about the quality of fish exports, officials said on Sunday.
Only two plants can continue to process fish for export, the ministry announcement said.
Officials said Spain had banned imports of frozen fish from Uganda.

Uganda has been exporting large quantities of frozen Nile perch, caught in Lake Victoria, Africas largest lake. Last years fish exports are estimated at $50 million, with Spain among the main destinations.
Officials said Spain and other European Union countries wanted better hygiene but local entrepreneurs said they could not afford to meet the standards.
About 1,000 workers were employed at the nine plants closed but officials estimate up to 10,000 other people, such as small-scale fishermen, would be hit by the ban.
